items.title: The Arms Modifier
items.do: Open Durgan's sheet and the HUD; Durgan uses a Basic Attack on the Orc Warrior; the Ogre Chieftain uses Crushing Grip and Hurled Goblin (a Goblin Sneak within its Reach) on Kaela.
items.expect: The sheet, the HUD and the class window say "Arms" (Modifier, DC) where they said "Weapon"; the Basic Attack's card reads "Arms vs. Armor Defense" and its traits "Arms · Strike · Weapon"; the roll adds the Arms Modifier. Crushing Grip and Hurled Goblin are [Arms] with no Weapon, and Hurled Goblin is no longer refused for the ogre's missing weapon (Doomed only if the ogre is Engaged, a [Ranged] Action).

items.title: The Charge, Snap Shot's Setup, the extra die without AP
items.do: Durgan Charges the Grave Wisp, then uses Drawing Light on it. Sylwen has Snap Shot: the Orc Warrior steps next to her. Aveline, with 2 AP left, opens Smite (2 AP).
items.expect: Drawing Light after the Charge is not Doomed for a repeat (the Charge's Basic Attack no longer counts); it is still Doomed if Durgan stands next to an enemy ([Ranged] while Engaged). Snap Shot opens its Setup (Evade 1, optional, the bottom bar) before the shot. Aveline's chip "1 AP: 1 more Smite die" is shown off with "No AP left for it" and can't be ticked.

items.title: Playtest 12's bugs: Rebuke's target, the first AP, Dying Flare, Difficult Terrain
items.do: In a new world, start a combat with the four pregens and the four creatures. Aveline (Rebuke) stands next to the Grave Wisp and selects her own token; the wisp moves away (and dies to the Rebuke if its Health allows). Then Kaela Advances through Aveline's square and a dark square she can't see in.
items.expect: The first creature of round 1 has its AP (4; a Minion 3). Rebuke's [R] 1d6! Holy goes to the wisp, not to Aveline. When the wisp's damage reaches its Health Pool, Dying Flare is offered (0R). Kaela's Advance charges what the ruler shows (each Difficult Terrain square 1 more). At the end of round 1, the last creature regains its AP (its Turn Log: "AP regained"), and round 2's first turn has them.

items.title: Rev 4 · Slip Away's Interact waits in the Situational tab
items.do: Kaela has Slip Away and a Dagger as well as her bow. The Orc Warrior ends its turn adjacent to her; use Slip Away. Then click the Situational tab and the granted Interact. On another round, use Slip Away again and press Cancel on the granted use.
items.expect: Use makes only her Evade 1: no Interact window opens. The Situational tab counts the granted Interact (0 AP, from Slip Away), and the Interact window opens only when she clicks it there; it costs no AP. Cancel skips it.
